correctness.rationale: The exact 16-vertex graph and every radius/neighborhood simplex are regenerated; every codimension-one Hasse incidence at each of the eight scales are completely acyclically sorted. At scale three one critical vertex and 47 degree-two cells remain; at scale four one critical vertex, 41 degree-four, and 2 degree-six cells remain, proving integral free homology without adjacent Morse differentials. At scale five an explicit signed 2-by-5 Morse matrix has one primitive rank-one image; all other stages have isolated critical dimensions. Sixty-four relative free-face collapses prove the scale-one-to-two H1 inclusion is an isomorphism; all other adjacent positive-degree groups are disjoint. Mod-two reductions independently check three key stages. Only a finite named-graph theorem is asserted.

value.rationale: The 16-vertex cubic symmetric Möbius–Kantor graph has a canonical intrinsic Čech filtration; a previous partial classification determined only high degrees. The new 47 degree-two bars and mixed simultaneous 41 degree-four and 2 degree-six bars complete the exact integral barcode and certify consecutive nonshellable nerves. The precise missing degrees and scales are motivated by this earlier partial classification and by the independently known Rips comparison, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
